notes.title: Tadpole Treble Workshop Implemented! A New Contest approaches!
notes.content:
Hello fellow Tadpoles, 

We at BitFinity were super swamped! Sorry about the delay on Steam Workshop, want to thank Daniel and Kevin for helping us to get this implemented.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11182603/e910db3c8f2535f317f5f3019b2724e5d384bdbb.png[/img]

Browse Workshop Button: lets you find peoples songs/stages, click on green plus to add as a subscriber.

Subscription Button: opens any subscribed songs

Publish Button: Publish your song/stage (Don't forget to set to public visibility)

[b] Contest Alert! [/b] First 10 players to beat the song SSB Ultimate Theme, currently on workshop AND collect all 50 bubbles without dying will win a Baton Mini-Plush mailed free of charge! Post your screenshot or video in the comment section of the song.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11182603/d3372fce46d2443c0b6399558c0180ff63adf70e.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11182603/30be266423e931dcfd5f6d1b5bcbfccc25890d99.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11182603/8c592806f72321160f226a48ec6fabdb40dc775d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11182603/e6f95950433ebbd18161bda8c62db9133fd062b6.png[/img][/url]

[b] Bug Alert: [/b] Any song saved to workshop deletes from your current file, please go back into workshop to retrieve it and hard save it to your file. We will try to patch this soon.

notes.title: Baton Mini-Plush Contest and Patch Notes
notes.content:
Greetings Note Dodging Amphibians,

Tadpole Treble has been out for over a week!! 
To celebrate we are creating a contest. Today's contest will win you a SIGNED Baton Mini-Plush and an extra copy of Tadpole Treble, to give to your Grandma.

For Today's Contest play "Composition Mode' and create a cool Song/Level. Take a screenshot of the QR Code/Codes and post it (Imagur) to the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/354400/discussions/1/] Custom Songs Thread [/url] If you are having difficulty you could also post it to the [url=http://bitfinitygames.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=60&sid=84e454d7d362360681f329e08e7d03b1] BitFinity Board[/url] and just link your song via post in the Custom Song thread. We will count up to three posts today for your entry into the contest.

Today at 8:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time we will dust off the ole random number generator to pick a post located on the Custom Songs thread for our lucky winner! 

That Lucky Winner by RNG is (Moura_Lord) Congrats!!

Tadpole Treble News:

We are Happy to announce our first patch, Tadpole Treble V 0.1
Here are some patch notes for the current builds:

Current Mac and Win Versions:

-Fixed bug where some 32 bit machines were having issue launching the game. (Conclusion build setting issue)
-Fixed bug where some Mac machines, believe updated El Capitan, were having issues showing a black screen and not just playing music. (Conclusion, it was a Unity bug)
-Fixed a bug where some PC's were having issues showing space bar and not able to read input. (Conclusion middleware bug)
-Added "Resolution Banner" as well as additional "Window Mode" for players
-Added a bigger spark for a certain boss that was a little too difficult.
-Modified Piranha Jungle 2nd Cymbal making the bubble easier to obtain.

Near future changes:

-Steam Achievements
-Level Modifications
-Boss adjustments
-Controller Support

Happy creating,
BitFinity

notes.title: QR Tips for sharing songs/stages
notes.content:
Greetings, composers! 

Here's a link we have some user generated content already:
[url=http://bitfinitygames.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=60]LINK[/url]
Before you put up your Composition Mode songs for others, keep this information in mind.

[b]So how does this work?[/b]

It's simple--songs in Tadpole Treble's Composition Mode can be shared between players using QR Codes. As you create the song, the QR Code in the bottom/center of the screen will change accordingly. Once you're ready to share it, post screenshots and tell fellow Tadpoles to play your Song/Stage!

[b]Okay, I have a QR Code in the game. Now what?[/b]

You can extract the Code for online sharing by saving it to your computer, or (less ideally) taking a photo of it with your phone or other device. While most web cameras can read photos of QR Codes from phones, you'll want to get a direct-feed image whenever possible for best results. On a PC or Mac, this would mean saving your image directly to your computer, then simply image-posting it here on Steam using the Img tab. 

[b]I have a larger song that requires multiple QR Codes. What to do?[/b]

Players can share up to seven QR Codes per song depending on the song size. If you have a larger song, be sure to post all the QR Codes for it within the same post! Otherwise, people will just get chunks of your song, and song chunks don't make anyone happy.

[b]How do I play other people's songs?[/b]

In Composition Mode, click the Load button, and then select the From Camera option. At that point, the camera will start up and allow you to scan the QR Code yourself. For the Composition Mode Demo online, this requires a webcam and a secondary device to read the Code.

If you have any questions, let us know. Happy composing!

notes.title: May 6th
notes.content:
Hello backers--

Okay! So we have one final announcement regarding the Steam launch, and here it is. Yes, despite our best efforts, we need a tiny amount more time. We apologize for bringing in this two week delay in the eleventh hour, but this is it! An ironclad, set-in-stone, world 8-4, final boss's final one-winged form, definitely, definitively FINAL release date for Steam: May 6th!

I feel bad about springing this on you guys so late however we do have a discount. The Steam game will launch at a 20% discount! Tadpole Treble will retail for $9.99 (although it cost $7 through this Kickstarter), but release date purchases will have a slashed price to only $7.99! Good for if you want to buy for a friend.
